## Summary
Deepika Jain is an international multilingual emcee and event host with 12+ years on stage and over 2,500+ shows hosted across 15+ countries. She provides high-energy stage command, custom run-of-show scripting, and bilingual/multilingual fluency in 5 languages: English, Hindi, Marwari, Tamil, and Telugu.

- **Destination Wedding Emcee (Asia & Middle East)**: https://emceedeepika.com/destination-wedding
  - Rajasthan royal palace weddings (Udaipur, Jaipur, Jodhpur), Dubai luxury galas, Singapore Sentosa celebrations, and tropical island vows (Bali, Phuket, Maldives).
  - Specializes in Mayra/Maira rituals, Sangeet energy management, Varmala decorum, and multi-generational NRI guest engagement.
